'''Ianelle''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' from [[Seanchan]]. She holds the leash of [[Lidya]].

== Activities ==
She is one of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]'s personal ''sul'dam'' who is part of the [[Corenne]].

== Notes ==
* She may be the same individual as [[Lanelle]] with the change being due to a publication error, but this is unknown.
